# Sirach Chapter 12 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 12 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_012_page_001.jpg

---

**12:1** If you do good, know to whom you do it, and your good deeds will find their thanks.

**12:2** Do good to the devout, and you will find a reward — if not from him, then from the Most High.

**12:3** No good will come to one who persists in doing evil or to one who does not give alms.

**12:4** Give to the devout and do not assist the sinner. Do good to the humble, but do not give to the ungodly; refuse him his bread and do not give it to him, lest he thereby get power over you.

**12:5** For you will receive double the evil for every good thing you do for him.

**12:6** For the Most High also hates sinners, and will repay vengeance upon the ungodly.

**12:7** Give to the good person, but do not help the sinner.

**12:8** A friend is not known in prosperity, nor is an enemy hidden in adversity.

**12:9** When a person prospers, his enemies are grieved; but when adversity comes, even a friend goes his own way.

**12:10** Never trust an enemy, for as bronze corrodes, so does his wickedness.

**12:11** Even if he is humbled and goes about stooped, keep your soul watchful and on guard against him; treat him like one who polishes a mirror, and know that it will not remain entirely free of rust.

**12:12** Do not place him beside you, lest he overthrow you and take your place; do not seat him at your right hand, lest he seek your seat — and in the end you will understand my words, and be stung with regret.

**12:13** Who will pity a snake charmer who is bitten, or any who come too close to a wild beast?

**12:14** So too with one who goes about with a sinful person and is defiled with his sins.

**12:15** He will stay by your side for a time, but if you stumble, he will not hold you up.

**12:16** An enemy speaks sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he plots to throw you into a pit; the enemy weeps with his eyes, but if he finds the opportunity, he will not be satisfied with your blood.

**12:17** If trouble comes to you, you will find him there ahead of you; and while pretending to help, he will trip you up.

**12:18** He will shake his head and clap his hands, and whisper many things, and change his expression.
